title: Which Day the Balance of a Closing Healthy Options Card Programme Is Settled As At
content:
The day as at which the balance of a closing Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme is settled is taken from the programme record where that record carries a last spendable day, and from the member's own request where it does not.

**The rule.** The closing day is the last day on which the allowance could be spent that the card record carries, where the card record carries such a day; it is the day the member gives their signature to the request, where the card record carries no such day and the member's request to close the card is waiting for that signature; and it is the day the member's request to close the card was taken in every other case.

| What the records show | The balance is settled |
|---|---|
| the programme record carries a last day on which the allowance could be spent | as it stood at the end of that day |
| no such day, and the member's request to close the card stands awaiting their signature | as it stands on the day the member gives that signature |
| no such day, and no request awaiting a signature | as it stood on the day the member's request to close the card was taken |

**Where each day is found.** The last day on which the allowance could be spent is the programme end day carried on the programme's own record. A request to close the card is an allowance service intake whose request action is the closure of the programme; the day it was taken is the day that intake was raised, and the most recent such request is the one read. A request awaiting the member's signature is one whose intake standing is that it awaits that signature.

**Worked illustrations, on hypothetical records.** A programme whose record carries a last spendable day: the balance is settled as it stood at the end of that day, whatever day the request was taken. A programme with no such day whose closure request stands awaiting the member's signature: the balance is settled as it stands on the day that signature is given. A programme with no such day whose closure request was simply recorded: the balance is settled as it stood on the day that request was taken.
